text: gah. sorry didnt mean to stop u but i also just found that stairs when skinned just drop them. and the same clash problem with walls that floors have
resolution: Two follow-ups to the floor clash. (1) Walls clash the same coplanar way floors do — the same dedupeColocatedPieces fix is kind-agnostic (keys on pieceId+position+yaw+edit+stampId), so colocated duplicate walls collapse too, in both the editor and the compiled world via liftBuildingsToTerrain. (2) Stairs lost their skin when baked/compiled — they shipped flat (their 'drop'): the bake's shape lowering reads piece.skin[box.slot], but the stairs step boxes in pieceShapes.ts were built inline WITHOUT a slot field (unlike the box() helper), so internMaterial got undefined and the step shipped as raw white with no material. The steps now carry their top/front slot, so skinned stairs ship their material like every other plate. Bundle-check passes. NOTE the separate 'walls not visible in iso3d but present in compiled' observation (req_0716) is the iso pane's W hide-walls toggle / floor-level cut-away, not a bug — no code change.
